name: Role Of The Husband
overview: Scripture presents the role of the husband as one of loving leadership and responsibility within the family. Husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially, as Christ loved the church, and to lead as the head of the wife, reflecting Christ's relationship with the church. This leadership is to be exercised with care and kindness, avoiding bitterness, while also nurturing and instructing children in the Lord. The virtuous wife is highly valued, and the husband’s role includes honoring and cherishing her in this God-ordained structure.
